opportunities.title: Document doesn't have a `<title>` element
opportunities.description: The title gives screen reader users an overview of the page, and search engine users rely on it heavily to determine if a page is relevant to their search. [Learn more about document titles](https://dequeuniversity.com/rules/axe/4.11/document-title).

opportunities.title: Page lacks the HTML doctype, thus triggering quirks-mode
opportunities.description: Specifying a doctype prevents the browser from switching to quirks-mode. [Learn more about the doctype declaration](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/lighthouse/best-practices/doctype/).

opportunities.title: Improve image delivery
opportunities.description: Reducing the download time of images can improve the perceived load time of the page and LCP. [Learn more about optimizing image size](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/performance/insights/image-delivery)

opportunities.title: `<frame>` or `<iframe>` elements do not have a title
opportunities.description: Screen reader users rely on frame titles to describe the contents of frames. [Learn more about frame titles](https://dequeuniversity.com/rules/axe/4.11/frame-title).

opportunities.title: Document does not have a meta description
opportunities.description: Meta descriptions may be included in search results to concisely summarize page content. [Learn more about the meta description](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/lighthouse/seo/meta-description/).

opportunities.title: `<html>` element does not have a `[lang]` attribute
opportunities.description: If a page doesn't specify a `lang` attribute, a screen reader assumes that the page is in the default language that the user chose when setting up the screen reader. If the page isn't actually in the default language, then the screen reader might not announce the page's text correctly. [Learn more about the `lang` attribute](https://dequeuniversity.com/rules/axe/4.11/html-has-lang).

opportunities.title: Use efficient cache lifetimes
opportunities.description: A long cache lifetime can speed up repeat visits to your page. [Learn more about caching](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/performance/insights/cache).

opportunities.title: Document does not have a main landmark.
opportunities.description: One main landmark helps screen reader users navigate a web page. [Learn more about landmarks](https://dequeuniversity.com/rules/axe/4.11/landmark-one-main).
